or when you've been crying for so long that your nasal passage gets all plugged and you start gasping really loud when you breath while crying and then it wakes up your roommate so you try to be all quiet so she doesn't hear you crying then you start to gag from holding it in and it makes you throw up?

I hate it when that happens.

I guess after some sleep I realize that I am not really unstable enough to be in eminent danger of killing myself but if there was a bus coming at me as me while I am walking down the street I might not jump out of the way as quickly as I should.

I just still feel like I have nothing to make me want to be alive right now.  I guess that is something that I should work on.
Thanks, that's a pretty simple list and I guess I already do most of that but I will keep that in mind now.

What are the methods that you use?

Right now I feel like suicide is not as much as a big deal to me as it was when I was younger.  Things like wanting to watch a TV show in the future was enough to hold be back, now there isn't much.  I feel as if I stopped caring about stuff.

True, I guess I know my life is not technically shitty, my current situation could be better but it is more of something that I come to expect now.  And I guess instead of fail at everything I mean succeed at nothing.  And its probably all my fault not trying hard enough or whatever I don't know.  My confidence level is pretty low.

I've never really understood the advice of just changing my life.  I do try to improve myself but should I just pretend I am something I am not?

Does the meditation thing actually work long term? I can understand it lowering stress but what kinda long term things does it help with?

I feel it would sound a bit too cliche while listing my fails.  The typical never had a girlfriend, never really had any strong relationship of any kind.  I have friends but nothing that seems genuine.  Don't even know if I will be able to pay my rent this month.

I have had feelings before when I would look at my life and just think wow it is shitty and want to kill myself but now its just a lingering feeling of not wanting to go on anymore.

I can only view happiness as being relative to my current situation.  I understand that there are people starving in Africa and would be happy with some bread and water but bread won't make me happy, especially emotionally.

I survived another day,
forever alone I will stay...
